component.name: SecureShell Go
component.summary: SSH terminal and SFTP client with strict host-key verification

description.p: SecureShell Go is a fast, security-first SSH terminal and SFTP client. Run a real interactive xterm-256color shell and transfer files over SFTP, with trust-on-first-use host-key verification at the core.

A changed host key blocks the connection outright, with SHA256 fingerprints shown for out-of-band verification and an explicit, checkbox-gated override required to proceed. Passwords, private keys and passphrases are kept only in encrypted secure storage.
Includes a saved host manager, password and private-key authentication, and an SFTP file browser for uploads, downloads and whole-folder transfers, alongside the terminal in the same session.
